newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa to name Montoro, Pimentel to board.
newsitem.headline: Endesa to name Montoro, Pimentel to board.

text.p: Spain's Empresa Nacional de Electricidad (Endesa) said on Tuesday it would name Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro and Labour Secretary Manuel Pimentel for seats on its board, to be approved by Wednesday's shareholders' meeting.
Endesa is still majority state-owned, and is due to be further privatised in autumn this year.

Endesa Chairman Rodolfo Martin Villa told reporters: "In the increase of the number of board members to be proposed to shareholders tomorrow, Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro and Labour Secretary Manuel Pimentel will be incorporated as representatives of the State Administration."

Endesa's shareholders will approve an increase in the number of board members to 18 from 12. New members will include two representatives of State holding company Sepi, Fecsa's chairman Juan Echevarria and Jose Luis Oller, director general of MEFF fixed-income futures.
The chairman of Sevillana Manuel Otero Luna will also be named to the board, replacing Fernando de Ybarra.
Fecsa and Sevillana's chairmen will become join deputy-chairmen at Endesa.
